0f23e514-a304-4360-a275-6264dc6299ae.plaintext: Because a form is a block, it sits on an ordinary page alongside the text that introduces it. There is no separate place to go and no separate thing to maintain. Easy and effective.

5b74a5ee-4a4d-46ff-9a94-6af7ec8db26d.plaintext: You assemble a form field by field: single lines of text, longer messages, dates, checkboxes, choices from a list. Each field takes a label and can carry a short hint explaining what is wanted, and can be marked as required so the form cannot be sent without it.
